hook.convey: a 4-digit number met in daily life (stadium crowd, game score) → it has 4 places: thousands, hundreds, tens, ones → reading and writing it = one digit per place

use.hi: Cricket match dekhne stadium mein 7465 log aaye, aur scoreboard par yahi number chamak raha hai. Aaj seekhenge ki aise 4 ank wale number ko kaise padhte aur likhte hain.
use.en: 7465 people came to the stadium to watch a cricket match, and the scoreboard shows that number. Today we learn how to read and write such a 4-digit number.

use.hi: Video game mein tumhara score 2938 hai. Dost ko score batana ho toh ise sahi padhna aana chahiye, aur sahi likhna bhi.
use.en: Your video game score is 2938. To tell a friend your score you must read it correctly, and write it correctly too.

explain.convey: 4 places hazaar | sau | dahai | ikai, one digit each; 7465 → 7 thousands, 4 hundreds, 6 tens, 5 ones → read place by place from the left

mustSay.en: each digit has its own place

point.hi: Dekho, 7465 mein 4 ank hain, aur har ank ki apni jagah hai: hazaar, sau, dahai, ikai. Hazaar ki jagah 7, sau ki jagah 4, dahai ki jagah 6, aur ikai ki jagah 5. Isliye ise padhte hain saat hazaar chaar sau painsath.
point.en: Look, 7465 has 4 digits, and each digit has its own place: thousands, hundreds, tens, ones. 7 in the thousands place, 4 in the hundreds place, 6 in the tens place, and 5 in the ones place. So we read it as seven thousand four hundred sixty-five.

simpler.en: Put each digit in its place: 5 in thousands, 1 in hundreds, 4 in tens, 6 in ones. Now read from left to right.

point.hi: Shabdon mein two thousand three hundred forty-five sunkar 2000 ke aage 300 aur 45 nahi chipkaate. Two thousand se hazaar ki jagah 2, three hundred se sau ki jagah 3, aur forty-five se dahai 4, ikai 5. Number bana 2345, sirf 4 ank.
point.en: Hearing two thousand three hundred forty-five, we do not stick 300 and 45 after 2000. Two thousand gives 2 in the thousands place, three hundred gives 3 in the hundreds place, and forty-five gives 4 tens, 5 ones. The number is 2345, only 4 digits.

simpler.en: On the board the 4 is in the box on the far left, the thousands place. Now think how much 4 thousands is.

remediation.move: abacus with 4 spikes: 5 beads, an empty spike, 2, 7 → every spike gets a digit, the empty one a 0 → 5027, never 527

say.hi: Abacus par 4 teeliyan hain: hazaar, sau, dahai, ikai. Har teeli ka ek ank likhte hain. Jis teeli par koi mani nahi, uske liye 0 likhte hain, use chhodte nahi, toh number mein 4 ank aate hain.
say.en: The abacus has 4 spikes: thousands, hundreds, tens, ones. We write one digit for each spike. For a spike with no beads we write 0 and never skip it, so the number has 4 digits.

simpler.hi: Khaali teeli ke liye 0 likho, use chhodo mat. 4 teeliyan hain, toh 4 ank.
simpler.en: Write 0 for an empty spike; do not skip it. 4 spikes, so 4 digits.

prompt.hi: Abacus 4 teeliyon wala hai: hazaar mein 8 mani, sau mein 3, dahai mein koi nahi, ikai mein 4. Number kya hai?
prompt.en: The abacus has 4 spikes: 8 beads on thousands, 3 on hundreds, none on tens, 4 on ones. What is the number?

why.hi: abacus ki 4 teeli: hazaar par 8 mani, sau par 3, dahai par koi nahi toh 0, ikai par 4 hain: 8304
why.en: the abacus has 8 thousands, 3 hundreds, no tens so 0, and 4 ones: 8304

simpler.hi: Har teeli ek jagah hai: hazaar mein 8, sau mein 3, ikai mein 4. Khaali dahai wali teeli ki jagah shunya likho.
simpler.en: Each spike is one place: 8 in thousands, 3 in hundreds, 4 in ones. Write zero for the empty tens spike.

bridgeToNext.hi: Abhi dekha ki khaali jagah par 0 likhna padta hai. Ab aise numbers likhenge jinke beech mein zero hain, aur unhe har jagah ki value mein khol kar likhenge, jise expanded form kehte hain.
bridgeToNext.en: We just saw that an empty place needs a 0. Next we write numbers with zeros inside them, and open them up into the value of each place, which is called the expanded form.

simpler.hi: Khaali jagah par 0 likhna hum dekh chuke. Agle hisse mein beech mein zero wale numbers likhenge aur unhe har jagah ki value mein kholenge.
simpler.en: We have seen that an empty place gets a 0. Next we write numbers with zeros inside, and open them into the value of each place.

hook.convey: a zero inside a number holds an empty place; drop it and the number shrinks (3060 → 36); in the expanded form that place adds nothing

use.hi: Video game mein tumhara score 3060 hai. Agar zero hata diye toh score 36 reh jaayega, bahut kam. Aaj dekhenge ki number ke beech ka zero kitna zaroori hai.
use.en: Your video game score is 3060. If the zeros are dropped, the score becomes 36, far less. Today we see how important a zero inside a number is.

use.hi: Train ke ek ticket ka number 7009 hai. Beech ke do zero hata do toh number 79 ban jaata hai, jo bilkul alag ticket hai.
use.en: A train ticket's number is 7009. Drop the two zeros in the middle and the number becomes 79, a completely different ticket.

explain.convey: teen hazaar nabbe: no hundreds → the hundreds place is empty but present → 0 holds it → 3090; without the 0 the 9 slides into hundreds → 390

point.hi: Teen hazaar nabbe mein hazaar ki jagah 3, sau ki jagah khaali, dahai 9, ikai 0. Khaali sau ki jagah par 0 likhte hain, toh number 3090 hai. Zero hata do toh 390 bachta hai, jo sirf teen sau nabbe hai.
point.en: In three thousand ninety the thousands place has 3, the hundreds place is empty, tens 9, ones 0. We write 0 in the empty hundreds place, so the number is 3090. Drop that zero and 390 is left, which is just three hundred ninety.

prompt.hi: Teen hazaar chhe ko numbers mein likho.
prompt.en: Write three thousand six in numbers.

why.hi: 3 hazaar aur 6 ikai, beech mein sau aur dahai zero: 3006; zero hata do toh 36, jaise 3090 se 390
why.en: 3 thousands and 6 ones, zero hundreds and tens between: 3006; drop the zeros and it is 36, as 3090 became 390

simpler.hi: Hazaar ki jagah teen hai aur ikai ki jagah chhe. Beech ki sau aur dahai ki jagah khaali hai, wahan 0 likho.
simpler.en: Thousands has three and ones has six. The hundreds and tens places in between are empty, so write 0 there.

explain.convey: seven thousand eighty: 7000 and 80 stuck side by side → 700080, 6 digits, too many; a number in the thousands has only 4 digits → 7 | 0 | 8 | 0 → 7080

point.hi: Seven thousand eighty ko 7000 ke aage 80 chipkaakar 700080 likhna galat hai, isme 6 ank ho gaye. Hazaar wale number mein sirf 4 ank hote hain: 7 hazaar, 0 sau, 8 dahai, 0 ikai, yaani sahi number 7080.
point.en: Writing seven thousand eighty as 700080, with 80 stuck after 7000, is wrong: that has 6 digits. A number in the thousands has only 4 digits: 7 thousands, 0 hundreds, 8 tens, 0 ones, so the right number is 7080.

prompt.hi: Nine thousand forty ko numbers mein likho.

why.hi: 9 hazaar, 0 sau, 4 dahai, 0 ikai: sahi 9040, 7080 jaise 4 ank; 700080 jaise 6 ank galat
why.en: 9 thousands, 0 hundreds, 4 tens, 0 ones: the right 9040, 4 digits like 7080; 6 digits like 700080 is wrong

simpler.hi: Hazaar wale number mein sirf 4 ank hote hain. Nine thousand forty mein sau ki jagah khaali hai, aur forty se chaar dahai milte hain.
simpler.en: A number in the thousands has only 4 digits. Nine thousand forty has an empty hundreds place, and forty gives four tens.

explain.convey: expanded form = each digit's value written separately; 6305 → 6000 + 300 + 5, 6035 → 6000 + 30 + 5; a zero place gives no part

point.hi: Expanded form mein har ank ki value alag likhte hain. 6305 mein 3 sau ki jagah par hai, toh 6000 + 300 + 5. 6035 mein 3 dahai ki jagah par hai, toh 6000 + 30 + 5. Zero wali jagah ka hissa likhte hi nahi.
point.en: In the expanded form we write each digit's value separately. In 6305 the 3 is in the hundreds place, so 6000 + 300 + 5. In 6035 the 3 is in the tens place, so 6000 + 30 + 5. The zero place gives no part at all.

say.hi: Hazaar wale number mein 4 jagah hoti hain: hazaar, sau, dahai, ikai. Jo jagah khaali hai, wahan 0 likhte hain. Zero chhoda toh baaki ank galat jagah khisak jaate hain, aur number bahut chhota ban jaata hai.
say.en: A number in the thousands has 4 places: thousands, hundreds, tens, ones. An empty place gets a 0. Leave the zero out and the other digits slide into the wrong places, and the number becomes far too small.

simpler.hi: Har khaali jagah par 0 likho. 0 chhodne se ank galat jagah chale jaate hain.

remediation.move: 4-box chart again: two thousand thirty → 2 | 0 | 3 | 0 → 2030; 2000 and 30 stuck side by side → 200030, too many digits for a number under ten thousand

say.hi: Hazaar wale number ke sirf 4 khaane hote hain: hazaar, sau, dahai, ikai. Bole gaye hisse ek ke baad ek chipkaate nahi; har hissa apne khaane mein ank deta hai, aur khaali khaane mein 0 aata hai.
say.en: A number in the thousands has just 4 boxes: thousands, hundreds, tens, ones. The spoken parts are not stuck one after another; each part puts its digit in its own box, and an empty box gets 0.

simpler.hi: Sirf 4 khaane bharo, har khaane mein ek ank, aur khaali khaane mein 0.
simpler.en: Fill just 4 boxes, one digit in each, and 0 in an empty box.
